author: iTerraCubist
body:
Hi My name is Jiff
IGN: LokighTheJiff
Banned cuz of: Please be nice in chat
Reason why i should be unbanned:
Sorry and excuse me for bursting out in chat out of nowhere but i just couldnt even express how mad i was after what happened, 1st thing i wanna say is that i didnt mean to direct it to anyone in the game, it was towards myself, because an application happened to pop up a window on my Minecraft screen when i was near the monument in the enemy's base, i tried to close it down but it ended up causing lag on my screen and it froze for a good 2 mins, thus my sneak key unshifted me ingame and i ended up dying 2 mins later after i managed to close down the application, ik it probs sound stupid but it just happened out of nowherr and in the wrong place and wrong time, i do feel really sorry if i bursted out way too much, i do regret what i did when not thinking about it as i was angered in the inside because of how close it was for me to tie that game.

P.s. ill get the screenshot of the application that popped up on my laptop screen, im making this appeal on my phone
